isolation: Parallel P86 source-line PR #206 exists. This is P85-MR-T1, not P86; do not modify that independent research.
objective: Finish reusable bounded FIT/CAL training algorithm for four P85 controls while exercising it only on invented in-memory toy episodes.

data.schema: list of independent episode dicts, EXACT action/effect float32 CPU tensors [T,16]; T in 2..96; no extra fields or oracle
data.source_status: No independently admitted Causal-Gymnasium source currently available. No external generation, loading, training or scoring.
data.sampling: Shared torch.Generator CPU seed 985299, sample 16 independent world indices with replacement per update, precompute index stream across all arms/seeds.
data.pad: Right-pad each world to batch longest T with unit action sentinel [1,0...], zero effect, explicit valid t>=1 and t<T mask. Padded output cannot affect earlier valid predictions.
data.loss: Masked physical delta MSE + .2*reward + .1*terminated + .1*truncated, never reward padding, never include first event with no prior history
data.cal: CAL only, unweighted mean of per-world four-delta MSE on t>=1; zero comparator same; CAL never backprops

training.checkpoint: Best CAL delta MSE; ties select earliest; deepcopy best weights and restore after run. Never use held-out DEV/OOD for selection.
training.competence: Actual science CAL requires best delta MSE <=0.75*zero on ALL 3 seeds for ALL conventional arms, otherwise SCIENCE_CONTROL_FAIL and STOP before OOD.
training.compute: One CPU thread, <=3 GiB peak RAM, <=3600s per full arm, report wall/params/source cost separately.

verification: Pre-source immutable protocol freeze committed first
Same sampler indices and index hash across kinds/seeds
Variable-length mask excludes padded histories and all first unprimed events
Padding/target mutation cannot alter earlier predictions or gradients
CAL metrics per-world length-balanced; training only FIT, CAL only for best checkpoint
Checkpoint selection obeys registered first-tie rule; exact restored trained state
No privileged labels, upstream simulator code import, external first-use, model/GPU dispatch or file IO
Toy mini-run of <=6 updates explicitly marked ENGINEERING_ONLY, protocol full 800-update NOT RUN
Original exact final SHA full G4 Windows/Ubuntu, G5 Win/Ubuntu, G7 Mamba2 CPU
